title: U.S., Armenia, and Azerbaijan launch trilateral planning groups
excerpt: Officials from the three nations inaugurated technical planning groups focused on transportation and electricity transmission.
bodyHtml:
According to a joint statement released by the US State Department, representatives from the Governments of the United States of America, Armenia, and Azerbaijan launched Trilateral Technical Planning Groups to advance the Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (TRIPP) on November 6, 2026.

U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for European and Eurasian Affairs Brendan Hanrahan, Armenian Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Trade Vahan Kostanyan, and Azerbaijani Deputy Foreign Minister Elnur Mammadov launched the multimodal transit route forum.

According to the statement, the forum brings together policymakers and technical experts to work collaboratively and contribute to long-term stability, economic vitality, regional connectivity, and commercial prosperity across the region, underscoring the August 8, 2025, Peace Summit Declaration brokered by President Trump.

According to the governments, the parties agreed to inaugurate the first two Trilateral Planning Groups focused on transportation and electricity transmission.
